objective: Reach a successfully built and cloud-QA-verified private Apify Actor with zero unauthorized monetary spend, then prepare for Store publication without publishing until economics, safety, pricing, and validation gates pass.

repaired_defects.resolution: Invalid/failed records use a separate aliased dataset instead of the default run dataset.
Runtime requires website-audit at exactly $0.001 and rejects nonzero default-dataset or actor-start synthetic pricing under PPE.
Missing Content-Type is classified UNVERIFIED_CONTENT_TYPE and remains uncharged.
DNS is revalidated at socket-connect time and connections are pinned to validated public literal IPs; environment proxies are disabled.
HTTP errors, non-HTML responses, missing Content-Type responses, and transient failed retry responses are classified from headers without downloading discarded bodies.
The Actor stops starting new network requests after a 600-second wall-clock safety budget.
The wall-clock test now patches only src.main.monotonic rather than the shared process-wide time.monotonic used by asyncio.
For PPE runs, ChargingManager is consulted before network work; if the run cannot fund even one website-audit event, the Actor exits before making a request.

public_billing_rules_verified_2026_09_03.free_plan: $0 subscription with prepaid platform usage; free accounts are blocked after prepaid usage is exhausted rather than entering paid overage.
public_billing_rules_verified_2026_09_03.paid_plans: Overage is possible beyond prepaid usage only while the account usage limit permits it.
public_billing_rules_verified_2026_09_03.limits: Billing > Limits / maxMonthlyUsageUsd is the account-specific hard monthly platform-usage control.
public_billing_rules_verified_2026_09_03.per_run_user_charge_cap: For PPE runs, maxTotalChargeUsd caps what the user can be charged for that run; it does not cap the developer account's uncharged platform cost across runs.
public_billing_rules_verified_2026_09_03.important_caveat: Public rules do not prove this account's actual plan, monthly usage limit, or overage state. Account-specific verification remains mandatory before any Apify cloud build or run.

bridge.behavior_without_token: CONFIG_REQUIRED; zero Apify network calls; zero paid actions
bridge.behavior_with_token: read-only calls to users/me, users/me/limits, actors?my=1; zero paid actions

locked_decisions: Replit is not on the critical path.
Direct public Git source import is the preferred Actor deployment source path.
Do not publish until cloud build, cloud QA, pricing, economics, and safety gates pass.
Do not incur monetary spend without explicit authorization for amount and scope.
Do not treat source QA or a GitHub Docker build as an Apify Cloud build.

current_blocker.description: Authenticated Console access and $0.00 current-month usage were observed, but the actual plan, current monthly usage limit, overage state, owned Actor inventory, and an assistant-controlled authenticated Apify route remain unverified. The hard zero-spend gate blocks cloud build/run actions.
current_blocker.owner_action_required: NONE_WHILE_ANY_ZERO_COST_AUTONOMOUS_WORK_REMAINS. Do not request another connector setup merely because the assistant-controlled browser path is unavailable.

next_action: Continue zero-cost economics/security review. Once an assistant-controlled authenticated Apify route exists, verify plan + Limits + current usage + owned Actors, prevent duplication, and build exactly one private Actor only if the zero-spend gate is proven. Publication remains gated.
failure_controls: Never expose APIFY_TOKEN in chat, logs, artifacts, source, or URLs.
Never treat local/source QA as cloud Actor QA.
Never treat Store preparation as publication.
Never substitute Replit for the verified GitHub/direct-Git path.
Never claim paid validation before actual paid usage.
Never ask the user to configure a new connector unless it becomes a genuinely unavoidable user-owned boundary after all autonomous routes are exhausted.
